channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Guthrie latest: FBI analyse glove DNA linked to doorbell footage
item.description: The search for Nancy Guthrie, the missing 84-year-old mother of US breakfast TV show host Savannah Guthrie, is still on-going.

item.title: Starmer U-turns on plan to postpone 30 local elections
item.description: 30 councils in England will go ahead with local elections in May after a legal challenge by Reform UK forced Keir Starmer into yet another U-turn.

item.title: ‘Government is showing poor judgment’, says Labour MP on local elections U-turn
item.description: We were joined by veteran backbench Labour MP Barry Gardiner.

item.title: Social media ban ‘doesn’t go far enough’ – NSPCC
item.description: Prime Minister Keir Starmer has promised to fast-track laws on social media use by children and young people, promising action "in months, not years".

item.title: More waste dumped on giant illegal site owned by King Charles – exclusive
item.description: Channel 4 News can exclusively reveal there's been renewed activity at the giant illegal waste site in Wigan on land owned by King Charles.

item.title: UK students take legal action over Covid-era university fees
item.description: Dozens more universities are now facing legal action from students who claim they didn't receive the education they paid for during the Covid pandemic.

item.title: What was the impact of the pandemic on society? Final module of Covid inquiry begins
item.description: The UK's Covid inquiry has now begun its final stage.

item.title: Weston-super-Mare: can this left-behind seaside town re-build?
item.description: The government has pledged to give local people the power to transform their communities with a scheme called Pride In Place, backed by £5bn in funding.

item.title: Iran holds military exercises on eve of US nuclear talks
item.description: Iran's foreign minister is in Geneva for the second round of high-level talks with the United States over its nuclear programme warning that any "submission before threats" would not be on the table.

item.title: ‘Godfather’ and ‘Apocalypse Now’ actor Robert Duvall dies at 95
item.description: Tributes have flooded in for the Oscar-winning actor Robert Duvall who died at his home in Virginia, aged 95.
